description: Helper for discovering AirGradient public sensors. Returns a curated list of well-maintained public sensors plus a hint to the AirGradient map for finding more.

privacy_mode.description: Optional privacy mode: summary | structured | raw. summary omits location identifiers and device serials when present; structured/raw return full payload.

query.description: Free-text city / region hint for the human.

name: air_search_public_sensors
title: Air search public sensors
